neighbours.label: words reporting that something has changed or been newly created in a society or system ('have changed', 'creating', 'lost their privileges')
fire: After the reforms, the old customs of the village have changed completely.
The revolution meant the nobles lost their privileges and the king his power.
Planners now focus on creating free-flowing rivers instead of dams.
Since the factory closed, the whole town has transformed.
Elders say their traditions have changed within one generation.
The new law abolished the old guild system overnight.
Hopes were high for a peaceful transition after the war.
Implants now act as substitutes for missing tooth roots.
quiet: The old customs of the village are still celebrated every spring.
The nobles held a feast in the castle for the king and his guests.
Planners now focus on the rivers that flow past the town.
The whole town gathers at the factory gate every morning.
Elders tell stories about their traditions around the fire.
The guild meets in the old hall on the first Monday.
The war lasted four years and ended in the spring.
Dentists check the tooth roots during each visit.

notes: Card peaks are spread over change/transition words; low confidence.
